spans.s: cira-khila (EI 30), land which was never cultivated.
cira-khila-śūnya (EI 23), epithet of gift land; fallow land.
cirañjīva (EI 30), ‘long-lived’; epithet of living (not dead) persons.
ciravida (CITD), Telugu; name of a coin; probably a special kind of gadyāṇa.
ciravida , Telugu; supposed to be a kind of gadyāṇa (q. v.).
cīrikā (EI 26), a document; cf. kraya-cīrikā, ‘a deed of purchase’, i. e. a sale-deed.
cīrṇa-vrat-opāyanaka (LP), the gift (upāyana) for the vows practised. Cf. Sel. Ins., p. 210, text line 14.
